mapper.select: SELECT curriculum.curriculum_item_id, curriculum.main_chapter_id, chapter.title, chapter.description, chapter.chapter_type, curriculum.display_order, curriculum.source_type, curriculum.status AS curriculum_status, curriculum.completed_at AS chapter_completed_at, CASE WHEN curriculum.completed_at IS NOT NULL THEN 100 WHEN NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sub_chapters active_sub WHERE active_sub.main_chapter_id = curriculum.main_chapter_id AND active_sub.is_active = TRUE ) THEN 0 ELSE CAST(FLOOR( 100.0 * ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sub_chapters completed_sub INNER JOIN user_learning_progress progress ON progress.sub_chapter_id = completed_sub.sub_chapter_id AND progress.user_id = curriculum.user_id AND progress.status = 'COMPLETED' WHERE completed_sub.main_chapter_id = curriculum.main_chapter_id AND completed_sub.is_active = TRUE AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM quiz_attempts completed_quiz WHERE completed_quiz.user_id = curriculum.user_id AND completed_quiz.quiz_type = 'SUB_CHAPTER' AND completed_quiz.sub_chapter_id = completed_sub.sub_chapter_id AND completed_quiz.status = 'GRADED' ) ) / ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sub_chapters active_sub WHERE active_sub.main_chapter_id = curriculum.main_chapter_id AND active_sub.is_active = TRUE ) ) AS SIGNED) END AS progress_percent FROM user_curriculum_items curriculum INNER JOIN main_chapters chapter ON chapter.main_chapter_id = curriculum.main_chapter_id WHERE curriculum.user_id = #{userId} AND curriculum.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY curriculum.display_order, curriculum.curriculum_item_id

SELECT sub.main_chapter_id, sub.sub_chapter_id, sub.title, sub.description, sub.display_order, published.content_version_id AS current_content_version_id, progress.progress_id, progress.content_version_id AS progress_content_version_id, progress.status AS progress_status, progress.last_page_id, progress.started_at, progress.completed_at AS progress_completed_at, progress.updated_at, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM quiz_attempts completed_quiz WHERE completed_quiz.user_id = curriculum.user_id AND completed_quiz.quiz_type = 'SUB_CHAPTER' AND completed_quiz.sub_chapter_id = sub.sub_chapter_id AND completed_quiz.status = 'GRADED' ) AS quiz_completed, ( SELECT active_quiz.attempt_id FROM quiz_attempts active_quiz WHERE active_quiz.user_id = curriculum.user_id AND active_quiz.quiz_type = 'SUB_CHAPTER' AND active_quiz.sub_chapter_id = sub.sub_chapter_id AND active_quiz.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' ORDER BY active_quiz.attempt_no DESC, active_quiz.attempt_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS active_quiz_attempt_id, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quiz_answers active_answer WHERE active_answer.attempt_id = ( SELECT active_quiz.attempt_id FROM quiz_attempts active_quiz WHERE active_quiz.user_id = curriculum.user_id AND active_quiz.quiz_type = 'SUB_CHAPTER' AND active_quiz.sub_chapter_id = sub.sub_chapter_id AND active_quiz.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' ORDER BY active_quiz.attempt_no DESC, active_quiz.attempt_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AND active_answer.user_answer_json IS NOT NULL ), 0) AS quiz_answered_count, COALESCE(( SELECT active_quiz.total_count FROM quiz_attempts active_quiz WHERE active_quiz.user_id = curriculum.user_id AND active_quiz.quiz_type = 'SUB_CHAPTER' AND active_quiz.sub_chapter_id = sub.sub_chapter_id AND active_quiz.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' ORDER BY active_quiz.attempt_no DESC, active_quiz.attempt_id DESC LIMIT 1 ), 0) AS quiz_total_count FROM user_curriculum_items curriculum INNER JOIN sub_chapters sub ON sub.main_chapter_id = curriculum.main_chapter_id AND sub.is_active = TRUE LEFT JOIN content_versions published ON published.content_version_id = sub.current_content_version_id AND published.sub_chapter_id = sub.sub_chapter_id AND published.status = 'PUBLISHED' LEFT JOIN user_learning_progress progress ON progress.user_id = curriculum.user_id AND progress.sub_chapter_id = sub.sub_chapter_id WHERE curriculum.user_id = #{userId} AND curriculum.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY curriculum.display_order, sub.display_order, sub.sub_chapter_id

SELECT curriculum.main_chapter_id, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM quiz_questions question WHERE question.usage_type = 'MAIN_CHAPTER' AND question.main_chapter_id = curriculum.main_chapter_id AND question.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND question.display_order IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM quiz_questions newer WHERE newer.question_key = question.question_key AND newer.version_no > question.version_no AND newer.status IN ('PUBLISHED', 'RETIRED') ) ) AS question_available, ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sub_chapters active_sub WHERE active_sub.main_chapter_id = curriculum.main_chapter_id AND active_sub.is_active = TRUE ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sub_chapters incomplete_sub WHERE incomplete_sub.main_chapter_id = curriculum.main_chapter_id AND incomplete_sub.is_active = TRUE AND ( NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_learning_progress completed_progress WHERE completed_progress.user_id = curriculum.user_id AND completed_progress.sub_chapter_id = incomplete_sub.sub_chapter_id AND completed_progress.status = 'COMPLETED' ) OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM quiz_attempts completed_quiz WHERE completed_quiz.user_id = curriculum.user_id AND completed_quiz.quiz_type = 'SUB_CHAPTER' AND completed_quiz.sub_chapter_id = incomplete_sub.sub_chapter_id AND completed_quiz.status = 'GRADED' ) ) ) ) AS all_sub_chapters_completed, attempt.attempt_id, attempt.status AS attempt_status, attempt.total_count, attempt.correct_count, attempt.score, attempt.started_at, attempt.submitted_at FROM user_curriculum_items curriculum LEFT JOIN quiz_attempts attempt ON attempt.user_id = curriculum.user_id AND attempt.quiz_type = 'MAIN_CHAPTER' AND attempt.main_chapter_id = curriculum.main_chapter_id AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM quiz_attempts newer_attempt WHERE newer_attempt.user_id = attempt.user_id AND newer_attempt.quiz_type = 'MAIN_CHAPTER' AND newer_attempt.main_chapter_id = attempt.main_chapter_id AND ( newer_attempt.attempt_no > attempt.attempt_no OR ( newer_attempt.attempt_no = attempt.attempt_no AND newer_attempt.attempt_id > attempt.attempt_id ) ) ) WHERE curriculum.user_id = #{userId} AND curriculum.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY curriculum.display_order, curriculum.curriculum_item_id
